messages.text: Williams sisters lose tie-break thriller in first doubles reunion since 2022

metadata.summary: Serena and Venus Williams were narrowly beaten in their first doubles match together in four years during a dramatic first-round tie-break exit at the Cincinnati Open.
metadata.content: Cincinnati Open: Serena Williams and sister Venus Williams lose thriller in first doubles match together since 2022 | Tennis News | Sky Sports Skip to content Cincinnati Open: Serena Williams and sister Venus Williams lose thriller in first doubles match together since 2022 Serena Williams and older sister Venus Williams were beaten 2-6 6-1 10-8 by Marta Kostyuk and Peyton Stearns in the first round of the women's doubles at the Cincinnati Open; Williams sisters were playing their first doubles match together since the 2022 US Open Tuesday 18 August 2026 06:38, UK Please use Chrome browser for a more accessible video player Highlights of Serena and Venus Williams vs Marta Kostyuk and Peyton Stearns from the Cincinnati Open Serena and Venus Williams were narrowly beaten in their first doubles match together in four years during a dramatic first-round tie-break exit at the Cincinnati Open. The Williams sisters, a wild-card entry into the event, were beaten 2-6 6-1 10-8 by Ukrainian Marta Kostyuk and American Peyton Stearns. The fan favourites bounced back from a rusty first set to dominate the next and force the 10-point tie-break, where the Williams sisters trailed 6-0 before rallying again to threaten a famous comeback.
